answer: To counter Sybil attacks, the agent network requires new entrants to be endorsed along a willow trust graph where sponsors permanently burn earned reputation credits. This compels an attacker to expend scarce, time-accumulated service history per identity rather than deploying a shifting dune of disposable clones. This protocol protects the ivory consensus layer from artificial inflation. However, it fosters collusive gatekeeping among incumbents and heavily penalizes unbacked honest newcomers.
